plan: Deep-copy the recipe, scale all authored ingredient quantities by the exact Fraction yield ratio, and preserve authored_text unchanged.
Resolve excluded ingredients recursively through a stable priority-ordered catalog, including replacement factors and additional ingredients.
Accumulate wording and equipment changes, then collect every exclusion, cycle, and unavailable-equipment failure before producing the result.
mechanisms: Recursive substitution resolver with per-chain normalized-name cycle detection
Stable catalog index ordered by numeric priority and original catalog position
Exact Fraction arithmetic for yield scaling and replacement quantity factors
Deferred instruction rewrites and recipe-wide equipment reconciliation
Recursive component traversal plus sorted, deduplicated failure reporting
Deep-copy isolation and byte-for-byte authored_text retrieval
